_comment: fpga_default: the FPGA bring-up starting point, the smallest VestaRV that still runs the boot ROM and the ISA regression - one hart, no second peripheral instances, and nothing that has no FPGA counterpart. Build with: make -C platform/common generate CONFIG=config/fpga_default.json (then plain make -C platform/common generate to put out/ and the tracked resolved config back to Castalia).
